primarySources.title: LinkedIn Research: Nearly 80% of people feel unprepared to find a job in 2026
primarySources.facts: The release reports 65% finding job search more challenging and identifies uncertainty about fit/skills among concerns. It describes natural-language search and job-match assistance.

methodology.geography: Listed markets include the UK, US, several European markets, Brazil, India, Singapore, Australia, Saudi Arabia and UAE.

primarySources.limitations: Consumer and HR samples are distinct. Pooled findings are not Saudi/UAE estimates; this page supplies no usable country split or complete questionnaire. January product rollout details do not prove November language/entitlement scope. Vendor outcome statistics are not adopted as causal evidence.

primarySources.title: What 1,500 Workers Revealed About Job Search Burnout
primarySources.facts: Reported 46% abandoning an application because of length or tedium and 47% pausing their search because of overwhelm.

methodology.population: US full- or part-time workers or temporarily unemployed people open to a new US job
methodology.weighting: Weighted to the US working population

primarySources.limitations: US-only, self-reported, active and passive search population. No basis for applying the percentages worldwide or to Gulf job seekers. Does not prove a specific interface change improves hiring outcomes.

primarySources.title: My Jobs: Managing Applied Jobs
primarySources.facts: The help distinguishes user-edited stages from employer/Indeed updates. External-site applications may lack these updates; application details and withdrawal are restricted to jobs posted directly on Indeed.
primarySources.limitations: Product help documents scope, not a reliability benchmark. Do not infer employer rejection from silence or treat a personal status as employer confirmation.

primarySources.title: Job Application Tracker
primarySources.facts: Documents job bookmarking, stages, notes, contacts, checklists and a free unlimited-job tracker; advanced analysis and broader writing tools are premium.
primarySources.limitations: Vendor-described workflow. No independent causal evidence for faster hiring. Existing Career Finder tracking and export work should be reused, not rebuilt.

primarySources.title: The Huntr Chrome Extension
primarySources.facts: Supported pages can populate saved-job fields and application forms. Unsupported saved-job pages remain manually editable. Autofill needs a visible application form and may not work where a site disallows the extension.
primarySources.limitations: This source does not establish pricing, every supported page or mobile parity. Support constraints make manual correction/fallback a core requirement.

primarySources.title: Use Copilot to autofill applications
primarySources.published: Page showed a relative update approximately 25 days earlier; no exact date inferred
primarySources.facts: Copilot fills supported fields; the user reviews and submits. Saving or filling is separate from employer confirmation. The guide provides manual copying/tracking fallback, document selection and warns that its resume feedback is not an employer screening result.
primarySources.limitations: Copilot guidance must not be generalized to the separate Autopilot service. Per-form support varies; this is not a claim that all competitors require manual final submission.

primarySources.title: Bayt.com Jobs: MENA Job Search
primarySources.facts: Advertises MENA discovery with industry, salary, location and experience filters. States CV creation, search and applying are free, with optional premium features.
primarySources.limitations: Marketing claims of verified jobs, scale or superiority are not independent evidence. Store listing was used because the older mobile-promo page redirects inconsistently. Prior recovered research already documents bilingual support.

primarySources.title: GulfTalent - Job Search App
primarySources.facts: Describes title/location search, role/industry/seniority filters, shortlists, alerts, application tracking and employer activity for Gulf/Middle East roles.
primarySources.limitations: Vendor description, not tested experience. Regional inventory is not worldwide coverage; Arabic UI and exact free/paid entitlement were not established by this selected page.

primarySources.title: Naukrigulf Job Search App
primarySources.facts: Lists English and Arabic, Gulf location/industry/experience/freshness filters, saved jobs and recruiter-related application indicators. It distinguishes the free app from paid career services.
primarySources.limitations: Publisher metadata does not establish localization quality, employer response rates or accessibility. Missing declared accessibility features is not proof of inaccessibility.

primarySources.title: EURES services
primarySources.facts: Offers European job mobility information and support, including living/working conditions and advisers. It directs CV creation to Europass rather than claiming its own CV builder.
primarySources.limitations: Useful regional alternative, not a worldwide board or an immigration eligibility decision. Linking to an official destination is not a Career Finder integration.

primarySources.title: Writing for Web Accessibility
primarySources.facts: Recommends meaningful headings and links, clear input/error instructions, concise sentences and ordinary language.
primarySources.limitations: Guidance is not a conformance audit. Apply natural English and Arabic independently; removing hype must preserve precise permissions, data scope and recovery instructions.

primarySources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2
primarySources.facts: Relevant web criteria include keyboard operation, reflow, programmatic language, visible/unobscured focus, minimum pointer targets and avoiding redundant entry. AA target size is 24 CSS pixels with specified exceptions; reflow addresses 320 CSS-pixel width.
primarySources.limitations: Apply the actual criterion and exceptions. Web checks are not a claim of native accessibility conformance, and reading the standard is not an executed accessibility pass.

surveyLimits: Indeed S02:1,501 US workers/job-open respondents, online YouGov6–15 August 2026, weighted to US working population;46% application abandonment and47% pause figures are self-reported, not worldwide/Gulf estimates.

LinkedIn S01:Censuswide 19,113 consumer respondents13–28 November 2025 and6,554 HR respondents10–27 November 2025 across listed markets including Saudi Arabia/UAE; pooled results are not country estimates and questionnaire/country splits are not established.
No representative Career Finder usability study or comparative hands-on benchmark was run; no universal-best-app or causal hiring-outcome claim is made.
